title: Kepler to Müller, 4 January 1630
author: Johannes Kepler
source: Johannes Kepler's letter to Philipp Müller written at Sagan on 4 January 1630, about the type and paper ordered at Leipzig for printing Tycho Brahe's observations, and the money held for him and Jacob Bartsch. The original is lost; the copy is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9 (89); 89, 8. M). First printed in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 70–71.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Kepler hopes the type and paper are ready at Leipzig and arranges carriage to Sagan, reports what he has heard of Bartsch at Strasbourg, and settles the accounts, resolved to go on printing whatever happens.

notes.note: The seat of the Margrave of Baden, whose secretary was Bartsch's rival for Susanna's hand (see Kepler's letter of 13/23 November 1629).
